mapper.insert: insert into ${alive_table}(role, updated_date, status, role_type) values('${role}', sysdate, 'MS', '${role_type}')
mapper.update: update ${alive_table} set role = '${role}' ,updated_date = sysdate ,status = '${alive_status}' where role_type = '${role_type}'
mapper.select: select count(1) as cnt from ${alive_table} where updated_date >= SYSDATE-(15/24/60/60) and role_type = '${role_type}'
